create_optimizer_nag: create a NAG optimizer with learning rate, momentum, and weight_decay parameters for PyTorch model
build_fairseq_nag_optimizer: build a FairseqNAG optimizer wrapping NAG with args and model parameters for fairseq training
run_optimizer_step: run a single optimization step on model parameters with gradient descent using NAG momentum
test_nag_with_closure: test the NAG optimizer step method with an optional closure that returns the loss
review_optimizer_config: review the FairseqNAG optimizer_config property that returns lr, momentum, and weight_decay settings
